remarks: Spacious two-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse in a quiet cove near downtown Stamford with an updated kitchen and dining area opening to a private patio, plus hardwood floors throughout. Easy morning commute via I-95 Exit 9 (less than 5mins). RENT INCLUDES HEAT, HOT WATER, COOKING GAS, 2 PARKING SPOTS, PRIVATE LAUNDRY, AND EXTRA STORAGE. Tenant pays electricity only. Conveniently located near Cove Island Park, beach, marina, Chelsea Piers, grocery stores, public transit, and Metro-North train. No pets. No smoking. Minimum 700 credit score required.
